period_note: SOLO/SEPARATE basis (the 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited)'/'Condensed Profit & Loss Account (Unaudited)' columns headed 'Eastern Bank PLC.', as distinct from the 'Eastern Bank PLC. and its subsidiaries' Consolidated columns printed side-by-side in the same press-release-style PDF). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (column header '01 January 2025 to 31 March 2025'), flagged via the _cumulative suffix, matching the CITYBANK schema convention and this EBL series' 2026_Q1.json. This 2-page condensed format (used every year from ~2016-2025) does not disclose authorized capital, NPL/classified-loans breakdown, CAR, or Tier1/2 capital — only the 24-page 2026-vintage filings do; these fields are genuinely absent from the source, not omitted by choice. RESTATEMENT FOUND: this contemporaneous filing reports EPS (restated) = 1.33 for Q1 2025. The later 2026_Q1.json filing's comparative column instead shows EPS = 1.13 for the same Q1 2025 period, with an IDENTICAL profit-after-tax figure (1,805,234,242 in both filings). This is a genuine retroactive EPS restatement from a bonus share issue that raised paid-up capital from BDT 13,581m (as of this filing) to BDT 15,958m (by FY2025 year-end per 2025_Q4.json) — IAS 33 requires restating all comparative EPS for the enlarged share count. Per project rule, this file keeps the earlier/contemporaneous EPS (1.33) since it is what this report itself states; the divergence is recorded here and in sources.json, and 2026_Q1.json documents the later restated figure. Not an error in either filing. Cross-checked the 31 December 2024 comparative column against bank_financials/EBL/quarterly/2024_Q4.json: total_assets (616,050,374,950 vs 616,050m), gross_loans (410,717,614,356 vs 410,718m), total_deposits (457,691,950,036 vs 457,692m), investments_securities (143,046,434,147 vs 143,046m), fixed_assets (6,318,911,387 vs 6,319m), borrowings (79,166,520,520 vs 79,167m), total_equity (43,063,636,095 vs 43,064m), paid_up_capital (13,581,390,540 vs 13,581m) — all match exactly, no discrepancy.
